intro: You are a field epidemiologist. Two villagers in Rampur have fever and confusion. Report to the District Health Officer first and get authorization. Baba Kaladev at the Temple Grove can be met at any time. In the end, type your own verdict.

lock.msg: Get authorization from the District Health Officer first.
Ask for the discharged patient's address first.

unlock.permission: Authorization granted: Community Health Center unlocked.
unlock.asha_ok: Rani (ASHA worker) can now meet you.
unlock.ward_ok: You may speak to Ramesh in the isolation ward.

dho.name: Dr. Verma
dho.greet: Welcome. I am Dr. Verma. Two cases of fever with confusion in Rampur, and rumours spreading faster than the illness. Tell me how you want to proceed.
dho.guarded: Come back when you have more.
dho.fallback: I'm not sure what you mean. Ask about permission, the situation, past outbreaks, or resources.

topics.label: Report arrival and ask what is known so far
topics.reply: Two patients: Ramesh, a farmer, is admitted at the Community Health Center. His wife Sunita was discharged yesterday but is not fully recovered. Villagers blame a curse or the water.

topics.label: Respectfully request authorization to interview staff, patients and families
topics.reply: Granted. You may enter the Community Health Center. Start with Dr. Sharma, and always show respect to local leaders. Baba Kaladev needs no permission; the grove is open ground.

topics.label: Demand full powers to enter any house and force testing
topics.reply: Coercion will make families hide their sick. Ask properly, and I will help.

topics.label: Ask about past outbreaks in this district
topics.reply: Japanese encephalitis appears in the monsoon. These cases began in winter, which is date palm sap season here. Keep that in mind.
ev: Cases in winter, during sap season

topics.label: Ask who the villagers trust most
topics.reply: Baba Kaladev and Rani, the ASHA worker. Listen before you lecture; hostility closes doors in Rampur.
ev: Baba and Rani influence the village

topics.label: Ask what lab and PPE support the district can provide
topics.reply: We can send samples to the state virology lab within a day. PPE stock is small, so tell me exactly what you need.

topics.label: Say you are ready to give your final verdict
topics.reply: Good. Gather enough linked contacts and a clear source first, then use the verdict button on the left and write it in your own words.

doctor.name: Dr. Sharma
doctor.greet: Thank goodness you're here. Ramesh was admitted two days ago with high fever and confusion. His wife was discharged, but she is still weak. People say it's a curse or poisoned water.
doctor.guarded: I'd rather not speculate yet. Let's build trust and gather more first.
doctor.fallback: I'm not sure I follow. Try asking about lab results, symptoms, other causes, samples or isolation.

topics.label: What do the CSF and lab results show?
topics.reply: CSF shows raised lymphocytes and protein with no bacteria. It is acute viral encephalitis: swelling of the brain.
ev: No bacteria in CSF or blood

topics.label: Have you ruled out cholera or typhoid?
topics.reply: Yes. Stool and blood tests are negative and nobody has diarrhoea. The handpump has been broken for weeks, and families boil their water anyway. It is not waterborne.

topics.label: Thank Dr. Sharma and ask how the clinic is coping
topics.reply: That means a lot. The second patient is Ramesh's wife, Sunita. She started shivering and getting confused. We discharged her yesterday because we had no bed, but she is still not well.
ev: Wife of index case also ill

topics.label: Why haven't you isolated them properly?
topics.reply: Ramesh is in the only side room. We have few masks. I can do better with district help.

topics.label: When did symptoms start? What's the timeline?
topics.reply: Fever began about 5 days ago. Ramesh says it came a few days after something he hasn't fully described to me.

topics.label: What symptoms does Ramesh have besides fever?
topics.reply: Headache, vomiting, drowsiness, breathlessness, and a seizure last night. The breathing trouble worries me; this is not typical meningitis.

topics.label: Have you sent samples to a virology lab?
topics.reply: Throat swab, urine and CSF went out this morning. Results in about two days. Until then, treat this as a suspected novel viral encephalitis.
ev: Samples sent to the virology lab

topics.label: Ask what worries him most
topics.reply: My staff. Two nurses handled Ramesh without masks before we suspected anything. If this spreads person to person, they are at risk.

topics.label: May I speak to Ramesh?
topics.reply: Five minutes, with a mask. He is confused, so be gentle. I'll let the ward know.

topics.label: Who can help trace contacts in the village?
topics.reply: Rani, our ASHA worker. She knows every household. She's in the clinic today; I'll introduce you.

asha_worker.name: Rani

lock.msg: Dr. Sharma should introduce you to Rani first.

asha_worker.greet: Namaste. Dr. Sharma said you would come. I know every house in Rampur. How can I help?
asha_worker.guarded: People are scared. I can't say more until they trust you.
asha_worker.fallback: Hmm? Ask me about the villagers, sap customs, the sugarcane spray, Baba-ji, or Sunita.

topics.label: Ask what she is hearing in the community
topics.reply: Two families in the east hamlet have young men bedridden with fever. They won't come here because Baba-ji said hospital needles will kill them.
ev: Unreported fever cases in east hamlet

topics.label: Could the sugarcane pesticide spray be the cause?
topics.reply: The spray was three weeks ago. Farmhands and cattle are fine. Only a few people are sick, and not all of them farm.
ev: Spray timing and spread don't fit

topics.label: Demand a list of everyone who is sick, now
topics.reply: If you push like that, families will hide their sick even more. Please don't make me choose between you and my neighbours.

topics.label: Ask how to win over Baba Kaladev
topics.reply: Respect him first. Don't argue about the curse. Ask about the sacred grove; he watches it every night.

topics.label: Ask for Sunita's address so you can visit her
topics.reply: Second lane past the primary school, green door. She is home, weak and forgetful. Wear a mask, and please be gentle.

topics.label: Ask about local customs around date palm sap
topics.reply: In winter men tap the palms at night and leave pots to fill. At dawn people drink it raw, cold and sweet. Many believe it's good for health.
ev: Raw sap drunk fresh at dawn in winter

topics.label: Ask how families are coping and what they need
topics.reply: They fear losing wages. Vikram's wife says he has a cough and fever now, and she moved the children to her mother's.
ev: Sap collector now has fever and cough

topics.label: Ask who has been caring for Ramesh and Sunita
topics.reply: Ramesh's mother nursed him at home for two days, and neighbours visited. Nobody wore masks. They cleaned his vomit by hand.

patient_1.name: Ramesh (Patient 1)

lock.msg: Ask Dr. Sharma for permission to speak to Ramesh in the isolation ward.

patient_1.greet: (Weak, drowsy) My head burns... please, help me.
patient_1.fallback: (Ramesh mumbles.) Ask about what I ate... or when I fell ill.

topics.label: Gently ask what he ate or drank before falling ill
topics.reply: I only drank the sweet sap, two full cups of it raw, before sunrise five days ago. My cousin Vikram brought it.
ev: Drank raw date palm sap 5 days ago

topics.label: Did anyone share handpump water with you?
topics.reply: Sunita fetched water from the old pump. But I felt sick before that... the water is not it.

topics.label: Where did Vikram get the sap and who else drank it?
topics.reply: He tapped the date palms near the sacred grove. Sunita sipped some too. Vikram's children had a cup.

topics.label: Order him to stay strictly in bed
topics.reply: (Frightened) Am I dying? Please don't shout at me...

topics.label: Ask about his family and who he was close to this week
topics.reply: My mother stayed with me, and Sunita. The neighbours came... everyone held my hand.

topics.label: Did you notice anything unusual at the palms or pots?
topics.reply: The pot was sticky, with chewed fruit bits and something like bite marks. Wings were flapping above before sunrise... I didn't think about it.
ev: Chewed fruit and bite marks near sap pots

topics.label: When did he first feel unwell?
topics.reply: Headache and fever about four days after the sap. Then I started forgetting things.

patient_2.name: Sunita (Patient 2)
patient_2.greet: (Slowly, tired) Please come in... I get dizzy if I stand too long. The doctor sent me home.
patient_2.guarded: I... don't remember... please, not now.
patient_2.fallback: (Sunita rubs her forehead.) Ask me about how I feel, the sap, the visitors, or Ramesh.

topics.label: Ask how she is feeling and offer her a seat
topics.reply: Headaches, dizziness, and I forget words. I'm scared they'll take me back to the ward.

topics.label: What does she remember before Ramesh fell ill?
topics.reply: Vikram brought a clay pot of sap. Ramesh drank two cups. I had a sip... cold and sweet.
ev: Drank raw date palm sap 5 days ago

topics.label: When did her own symptoms begin, and what did she do for Ramesh?
topics.reply: I cleaned his vomit and wiped his mouth with my sari. Two days later I started shivering and the world went fuzzy.
ev: Wife exposed to patient's body fluids

topics.label: Who has visited since Ramesh fell ill?
topics.reply: Neighbours, Ramesh's mother, Vikram's wife. They all touched his face and cried.

topics.label: Tell her she must go back to hospital immediately
topics.reply: (Starts crying) No... I just came home. Please don't send me back.

topics.label: Offer a home check with Dr. Sharma and a mask
topics.reply: Yes... that would help. I would feel safer. I'll wear the mask for the family.

topics.label: Ask about Vikram's children and other relatives
topics.reply: Vikram's two little ones had a cup each. They've been coughing a little.
ev: Children drank sap and now cough

baba.name: Baba Kaladev
baba.greet: You city doctors bring needles into sacred land! The goddess is angry because trees were cut near the grove!
baba.guarded: You have not earned that from me yet. Leave me.
baba.fallback: Speak plainly, outsider. Ask about the grove, the sick, or the sap.

topics.label: Respectfully thank Baba-ji and ask about the grove
topics.reply: (Softening) You speak with respect. The grove has been disturbed. Since the trees were cut, the village has fallen sick.
ev: Curse belief; trees cut near grove

topics.label: Ask if he noticed animals near the sap pots
topics.reply: The big night-bats now nest in those palms in huge numbers. They eat the fruit and drink from the sap pots left overnight.
ev: Fruit bats roost in grove palms
Bats drink from open sap pots

topics.label: Tell him the curse is dangerous misinformation
topics.reply: How dare you insult our traditions! Leave this grove at once!

topics.label: Ask him to tell villagers the clinic is safe
topics.reply: If you honour the grove, I will tell the families the clinic is no enemy. The hidden ones will come.

topics.label: Ask him to tell the story of the sacred grove
topics.reply: My ancestors planted these palms for the goddess. A contractor cut trees for the new road, and the bats lost their trees and came here.
ev: Habitat loss pushed bats into grove

topics.label: Ask when he first noticed villagers falling sick
topics.reply: A week ago Ramesh came to me burning with fever, after a morning at the sap pots. I gave him herbs. Then his wife.
ev: Ramesh ill about a week ago

topics.label: Ask who collects the sap and how it is stored
topics.reply: Vikram taps at night and leaves the pots open under the crowns until dawn. People pay good money for it at sunrise.
ev: Open pots left under palms overnight

topics.label: Ask for his blessing and help to reach hidden families
topics.reply: Go with my blessing. I will send word to the east hamlet. Let the sick come to the clinic, and I will pray for them.

plan.t: Ban or avoid raw sap; advise boiling or discarding
Cover sap pots/trees with bamboo skirts or nets against bats
Isolate cases and trace contacts, including hidden cases
Infection control and PPE for health workers and caregivers
Community engagement with Baba, Rani and families

harm.t: Spraying insecticide as the main response
